hooks.prompt: A SKILL.md file was just edited. Check the YAML frontmatter at the top: does it include both 'name:' and 'description:' fields? Does the description string have proper quoting if it contains parentheses, dashes, or special characters? If anything looks off, respond with a one-line concrete fix suggestion (e.g. 'Quote description: "..."'). Otherwise respond with empty string. Tool input: $ARGUMENTS
